2610.10858.title: RFChipAgent: Multi-Agentic AI Flow for Analog/RF Chip Design
2610.10858.paper_summary: Analog/RF circuits remain the critical interface between digital computation and the physical world, and emerging standards from Wi-Fi 7 to 6G place stringent demands on them, yet analog/RF design remains one of the most labor-intensive steps in chip development. We present RFChipAgent, a first-of-its-kind multi-agent flow of large language model (LLM) agents for end-to-end analog/RF circuit design automation, in which AI agents collaboratively orchestrate the complete design flow under human supervision. RFChipAgent is built around four technical pillars. First, a multimodal retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) subsystem with private per-document FAISS indexing extracts design knowledge from existing engineering documentation. Second, a topology agent drives topology selection, and a schematic and testbench agent automates circuit and testbench assembly. Third, a closed-loop hybrid circuit-sizing engine combines Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and CMA-ES optimization, evaluating every candidate in a simulator-in-the-loop framework. Fourth, a trust-scored simulation database accumulates verified performance data and builds an adaptive optimization model that informs subsequent trials. We validate RFChipAgent on a family of GF22FDSOI 60 GHz wideband mm-wave low-noise amplifier (LNA) topologies, demonstrating automated topology generation, specification-driven design-space exploration, and simulator-guided optimization. Experimental results show substantial reductions in design effort while maintaining signoff-quality verification. This work establishes a foundation for LLM-driven multi-agent electronic design automation (EDA) for analog/RF circuits.
2610.10858.paper_summary_zh: 類比/射頻電路仍然是數位計算與物理世界之間的關鍵接口，從 Wi-Fi 7 到 6G 的新興標準對它們提出了嚴格的要求，但類比/射頻設計仍然是晶片開發中最勞動密集的步驟之一。我們提出了 RFChipAgent，這是一種首創的多代理大型語言模型（LLM）代理的端到端類比/射頻電路設計自動化流程，其中 AI 代理在人工監督下協同協調完整的設計流程。RFChipAgent 建立在四個技術支柱之上。首先，一個多模態檢索增強生成（RAG）子系統，通過私有每文檔的 FAISS 索引，從現有的工程文檔中提取設計知識。其次，一個拓撲代理驅動拓撲選擇，而一個原理圖和測試平台代理則自動化電路和測試平台的組裝。第三，一個閉環混合電路尺寸引擎結合了樹狀帕爾岑估計器（TPE）和 CMA-ES 優化，在模擬器環中評估每個候選者。第四，一個信任評分的模擬數據庫累積了經過驗證的性能數據，並建立了一個自適應優化模型，以指導後續的試驗。我們在一系列 GF22FDSOI 60 GHz 寬帶毫米波低噪聲放大器（LNA）拓撲上驗證了 RFChipAgent，展示了自動化的拓撲生成、以規範驅動的設計空間探索和模擬器引導的優化。實驗結果顯示設計工作量大幅減少，同時保持了簽核質量的驗證。這項工作為基於 LLM 的多代理電子設計自動化（EDA）在類比/射頻電路中的應用奠定了基礎。
